{"triples": [{"subject": "Language Model", "predicate": "uses", "object": "Jelineck-Mercer smoothing", "object_type": "Method", "source_sentence": "For the retrieval model we used the LM-JM (Language Model with Jelineck-Mercer smoothing) with the smoothing parameter set to 0.6 as suggested in."}, {"subject": "Experiments", "predicate": "uses", "object": "word2vec", "object_type": "Method", "source_sentence": "We employ three different embedding strategies for our experiments : i) standard word2vec, ii) transformed vectors with temporal context , and iii) transformed vectors with temporal contexts."}]}
